title: Multiplication by $X$ modulo a binary polynomial
statement: Let $\ell$ be positive, and let $m,a\in\mathbb{F}_2^\ell$. Define a vector whose coefficient at position $d$ is the shifted coefficient of $a$ at $d$ plus $a_{\ell-1}m_d$, with addition and multiplication in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
